statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.

Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is medically necessary to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic instability that may be contributing to these syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion.
The diagnoses are R55 and G45.9.
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204.
